units.rawText: My most sincere apologies for starting a fire in the kitchen the last time I was there. You may deduct the necessary repair fees from my pay.

units.rawText: I never would have imagined that kitchens rejected physical laws in such a manner. To think that water would fail to put out a fire inside a pan... Huh? Oil fires can't be put out with water?

units.rawText: I see how it is, someone must have placed a hazard in your vicinity with the goal of harming you! I've failed... To allow such threats to be in your proximity…
